name: OneLake security - dynamic and multi-table RLS
description: OneLake security is adding support for dynamic and multi-table row level security. With dynamic RLS, users can create roles in OneLake that secure data differently for each user that queries the data. In addition, multi-table RLS allows data to be secured by querying values in a lookup table. Combined, these features empower users to complex RLS rules for securing enterprise data. The initial launch will support SQL endpoint, Power BI, and Fabric Spark.

result.nameEs: OneLake security: RLS dinámica y entre varias tablas
result.descriptionEs: OneLake security admitirá seguridad por filas dinámica, que filtra los datos de forma distinta para cada usuario, y RLS entre varias tablas, basada en valores de una tabla de consulta. Al principio funcionará con el SQL endpoint, Power BI y Fabric Spark.
